common.helpAlways: Pin help text on click (stay open until dismissed)

dgr.adminHint: UDP/QUIC tunnel for Starlink and carrier NAT. Auto-enabled when P2P mode is CGNAT, both, or classic.
dgr.liveHint: Restart the node after changing DGR settings. Shows the running QUIC relay from GET /api/dgr.
dgr.warnNoRelay: Outbound relay not registered - add relay seeds or wait for P2P peers with NODE_DOGEGO_RELAY_CGNAT.

dashboard.tlsCertHint: If your browser shows a certificate warning, that is normal for DogeGo local HTTPS. Traffic is encrypted on this machine. Trust the DogeGo local CA in Settings → Interface to remove the warning, or run dogego tls trust-ca.

wizard.title: DogeGo - setup

stepMeta.title: Choose your setup
stepMeta.desc: Pick one profile - you can fine-tune details on the next screens.

stepMeta.title: Data folder
stepMeta.desc: Where chain files live. Network and mode come from your profile.

stepMeta.title: Network & checks
stepMeta.desc: P2P connectivity, firewall, and automatic port/CGNAT checks.

stepMeta.title: Sync & indexer
stepMeta.desc: Full-node download options (skipped in SPV mode).

stepMeta.title: Dashboard & finish
stepMeta.desc: Web UI, optional PIN, then start the node.

wizard.profileEssential: Tap a card below. Each option sets network, node mode, wallet, and P2P defaults for you.

firstRun.title: Try testnet
firstRun.sub: Full node · wallet on · best for first run

mainnet.title: Mainnet full node
mainnet.sub: Production Dogecoin - longer sync, full validation

mainnetWallet.title: Mainnet + wallet
mainnetWallet.sub: Full node with Send/Receive - set a dashboard PIN on finish

wizard.showAdvanced: Show advanced options on later steps
wizard.loadingSave: Saving configuration and starting your node…
wizard.tlsCertHint: If your browser shows a certificate warning, that is normal for DogeGo local HTTPS. The dashboard uses an auto-generated certificate so traffic stays encrypted on this machine. Trust the DogeGo local CA (enabled by default) to remove the warning, or disable HTTPS later in Settings → Interface.
wizard.loadingHttpsHint: Opening encrypted dashboard… A one-time browser certificate notice is normal until the DogeGo CA is trusted.
wizard.dataEssential: Pick a data folder and network. Leave peer discovery automatic unless you have a known seed.
wizard.networkEssential: Connectivity and automatic checks before you start. Use cgnat on Starlink or when you cannot port-forward.
wizard.syncEssential: Full node downloads the chain. Recommended disk layout is on by default: bundled blk*.dat files, zstd compression, and a compact tx index (full explorer search still works).
wizard.spvSkip: SPV mode - full-node sync options are not used. Continue to P2P.
wizard.finishEssential: Dashboard listens on 127.0.0.1 by default. Set an optional PIN to lock the web UI (Send and wallet view).
wizard.backupBody: Download a copy of wallet.json and store it offline in a safe place. Without a backup you cannot recover funds if this device fails.
wizard.backupEncryptWarning: This file contains your HD seed and all private keys (including imports) in plain text unless you encrypt the wallet. Set a dashboard PIN on the previous step (locks this UI only), then after start run Console → encryptwallet with a strong passphrase to encrypt wallet.json on disk. Treat backups like cash. Store offline and encrypted when possible.
wizard.pinNotWalletEncrypt: Optional: leave unchecked to start without a dashboard PIN. When enabled, both fields must be exactly 6 digits and match. Dashboard PIN is hashed in web_security.json per network and gates the web UI only; it does not encrypt wallet.json. Dual mainnet + testnet: the same PIN is saved for both dashboards (localhost:2013 and :2014). Use wallet encryption on the finish step for on-disk key encryption on both networks.
wizard.backupPending: Download your wallet backup, then confirm you have stored it safely.
wizard.backupConfirm: Backup downloaded - check the box below after you have stored it safely.
wizard.backupReady: Backup acknowledged. You can start the node.
wizard.backupAck: I have saved my wallet backup in a safe place
wizard.backupAckRequired: Confirm that you have saved your wallet backup before starting.
wizard.walletEncryptHint: On by default for new installs. Download the backup first (plaintext until encrypted). Uncheck only if you accept a plaintext wallet; you can encrypt later in Settings → Wallet.
wizard.walletPassRequired: Enter a wallet passphrase when encryption is enabled.
wizard.walletPassMismatch: Wallet passphrase and confirmation must match.
wizard.preflightHint: Runs when you open this step - firewall, ports, and CGNAT hints.
wizard.footLove: Coded with love to all Dogecoin community.
wizard.footSaved: Saved to dogecoinconf.json - change anytime in dashboard Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.essentialDesc: Change network, data folder, and dashboard PIN here. Restart the node after changing paths or P2P.
settings.advancedDesc: Saved to dogecoinconf.json. Most options apply after you restart dogego node. Hover ? on each field for short help.
settings.servicesHint: Start or stop subsystems immediately. Config in the tabs below applies on the next node start unless noted.
settings.extensionsHint: Optional DogeGo extensions. Browse catalog sources, install zip packages, enable or disable. Open an enabled extension for its workspace menu. Wallet use is allowlisted RPC only (no key export).
settings.extensionsCatalogSourcesHint: GitHub folder or raw catalog.json URLs. Default includes the official DogeGo extensions catalog.
settings.walletHint: Built-in HD wallet settings. Post-quantum OP_RETURN commitments apply on the next send when enabled below.
settings.walletEnableHint: Uncheck to set nowallet in config. Save config and restart the node for this to take effect.
settings.walletEncryptHint: Encrypts wallet.json on disk (Core encryptwallet). Separate from the dashboard PIN in Settings → Interface.
settings.walletEncryptOff: Wallet file is not encrypted. Set a passphrase below to encrypt wallet.json on disk.
settings.walletEncryptLocked: Spend keys locked. Unlock to send or sign (Core walletpassphrase).
settings.walletPqHint: When on, each send attaches a Phase-1 OP_RETURN commitment (FLC1 by default). Saved to wallet.json immediately.
settings.walletDisabledConfig: Wallet disabled in config (nowallet). Save config and restart the node to re-enable.
settings.walletUnavailable: Wallet not loaded on this run.
settings.walletPqOn: Post-quantum sends on - {tag} OP_RETURN attached on each send.
settings.walletPqOff: Post-quantum sends off. Enable below to attach FLC1 commitments.
settings.walletPqCarrierOn: PQ carrier sends enabled - TX_C/TX_R P2SH pair available on Send → Advanced.
settings.walletPqCarrierOff: PQ carrier sends off. Enable pq_carrier below for TX_C/TX_R sends.
settings.syncHint: Controls historical block download and local indexes. Ignored when node mode is SPV.
settings.toolsHint: Run common RPC commands with guided forms. Organized by category; no Console tab required.
settings.p2pHint: How many peers to maintain and whether to accept inbound connections. Restart required.
settings.dgrHint: After Save, restart the node. Live metrics: Overview → Network or the panel below.
settings.dgrSetupLead: Two roles: pick one. This is separate from Dogecoin P2P port 22556 (TCP).
settings.dgrPathClientBody: For Starlink, mobile, or home networks without inbound. You dial out to a public DogeGo relay over QUIC UDP, with no router port forward on your side.
settings.dgrPathClientPorts: Your node: outbound UDP to relay:24433 · Dogecoin P2P stays outbound TCP only.
settings.dgrPathOperatorBody: For a VPS or home server with a public IP. You host the QUIC relay so CGNAT clients can tunnel through you.
settings.dgrPathOperatorPorts: Forward UDP 24433 on your router/firewall to this machine (TCP 22556 is normal P2P, not the relay).
settings.dgrRoleClientSub: No port forward · dial public relays
settings.dgrSuggestCgnat: Tip: choose Use relay (client) above, add the operator's host:24433 under Public relay addresses, then Save and restart.
settings.dgrSuggestBoth: Tip: if you cannot accept inbound P2P, choose Use relay (client). If you have a public IP and want to help others, choose Run relay (operator) and open UDP 24433.
settings.interfaceIntro: Customize the dashboard layout, PIN security, and how the web UI is served.
settings.updatesHint: Checks GitHub Releases daily. Disable with DOGEGO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1.
settings.simpleHint: Full menu is shown by default. Simple mode hides operator-only tabs.
settings.navTogglesHint: Choose which sections appear in the sidebar and bottom bar:
settings.securityChecklistHint: Live status from this node. Save config and restart when you change binds or TLS.
settings.securityChecklistEncryptWarn: Mainnet wallet still plaintext; encrypt before depositing or sending
settings.securityChecklistRpcAuthWarn: Enable rpc_cookie or rpc_user/password before exposing RPC
settings.securityChecklistRpcLoopOk: JSON-RPC bound to loopback or disabled
settings.securityChecklistRpcLoopWarn: JSON-RPC listens beyond loopback; use TLS and auth
settings.securityChecklistWebLoopWarn: Dashboard listens beyond loopback; enable webui_remote_auth PIN and TLS
settings.securityChecklistRemoteAuthWarn: Non-loopback dashboard without webui_remote_auth; balance/history may leak on LAN
settings.securityChecklistTlsInfo: Optional: enable local HTTPS under Local HTTPS below
settings.localTlsIntro: New wizard installs enable HTTPS unless you started with -notls / DOGEGO_NO_TLS=1 (DogeBox). Turn HTTPS off here for plain HTTP. When on, DogeGo generates a local CA under datadir/tls/; restart after Save.
settings.localTlsTrustHint: Also: dogego tls trust-ca from a terminal. Linux Chrome needs libnss3-tools (certutil). Firefox uses its own store; import local-ca.crt manually.
settings.localTlsStatusOff: Local HTTPS off (plain HTTP). Enable toggles above, Save, and restart.
settings.localTlsStatusOn: HTTPS active after restart. CA trusted in this user account.
settings.localTlsStatusUntrusted: HTTPS certs ready; CA not yet trusted. Browsers will warn until you install the CA.
settings.localTlsTrustOk: Local CA installed in OS user trust store.
settings.walletRescanStarted: Wallet rescan started in the background.
settings.walletRescanNeeds: Wallet index through block {indexed}; chain at {tip}. Rescan backfills transaction fee and hex metadata.
settings.walletRescanNeedsFastPath: Wallet indexed through block {indexed}; chain at {tip}. History is fast; rescan backfills fee and hex metadata.
settings.walletRescanOk: Wallet index is up to date through block {tip}.
settings.walletHistoryFastPath: Wallet history indexed (fast listtransactions for receive rows).
settings.walletListtransactionsUtxoWalk: listtransactions walks {n} UTXOs for receive history; run rescan to build wallet.db index.
settings.advancedHint: Core-style policy keys in dogecoinconf.json (koinu per kB unless noted).
settings.zmqHint: PUB endpoints for bots/exchanges (tcp://127.0.0.1:28332 or 127.0.0.1:28332). Restart required.
settings.coreParityHint: Only if you run Dogecoin Core beside DogeGo to check protocol parity with the original reference node. Leave blank for a fully autonomous DogeGo node. Applies after Save -  no restart.
settings.signerCmdHint: HWI-compatible stdin/stdout JSON (enumeratesigners, signerdisplayaddress, PSBT signing). Restart required after Save.
settings.restartModalBody: Configuration saved successfully. Most settings apply after you restart DogeGo.
settings.restartModalManualBody: DogeGo will restart and the dashboard will reconnect in a few seconds.
settings.restartModalAutostartHint: Restart will not start DogeGo automatically at login until autostart is registered. Start DogeGo manually after restart, or run it once with administrator privileges to enable login autostart.

datadir.label: Data directory
datadir.help: All chain files and dogecoinconf.json live here. Separate subfolders per network. Not compatible with Dogecoin Core's data directory.
datadir.hint: Created if missing. DogeGo uses its own layout (headers.bin, rawblocks/, indexes/) - not Dogecoin Core's blocks/ or chainstate/.

network.label: Network
network.help: mainnet = real Dogecoin. testnet = reboot testnet for development (recommended for first try).

nodeMode.label: Node mode
nodeMode.help: full = download block bodies (needed for explorer and most RPC). spv = headers only, much smaller disk use.

peer.label: Peer (optional)
peer.help: One host:port to connect to first. Leave empty unless you know a reliable seed peer.

p2p.label: P2P connectivity
p2p.help: cgnat = outbound only (Starlink/CGNAT). classic = inbound listen. both = default mix with extra outbound relays.

firewall.label: OS firewall
firewall.help: auto = add Windows/Linux/macOS rules for P2P when missing. always = always manage rules. never = skip OS firewall.

upnp.label: UPnP / NAT-PMP
upnp.help: auto = map P2P port on your router when listening (classic/both). enable = always try. disable = off (Core -upnp=0).

maxOutbound.label: Max outbound
maxOutbound.help: Total outbound P2P sessions including the primary sync peer. More peers can speed block download.

maxInbound.label: Max inbound
maxInbound.help: Incoming connections when listening is enabled (classic/both modes).

noTxIndex.label: Disable transaction index
noTxIndex.help: When on, skips building indexes/tx. Saves disk but limits explorer tx/address search. Leave off for full explorer.

blockLayout.label: Block storage layout
blockLayout.help: bundled (recommended): Core-style blk*.dat files, less filesystem overhead. perfile: one .bin file per block (legacy).

blockZstd.label: Compress stored blocks (zstd)
blockZstd.help: Transparent compression on disk. P2P still sends normal wire blocks. Saves disk on full nodes.

txEmbed.label: Embed full tx bytes in tx index
txEmbed.help: When off (recommended), index stores only block pointers; txs load from block files. When on, duplicates tx bytes in the index.

analytics.label: Embedded analytics sidecar
analytics.help: Optional Pebble catalog for the Analytics tab. Safe to disable on small disks; you can run dogego indexer from CLI instead.

ibdOptimize.label: Optimize initial block download
ibdOptimize.help: When on (default), DogeGo prioritizes headers-first sync and parallel block download during IBD: more assist peers, Core-style assumevalid script skip on buried blocks, keeps the UTXO set in RAM longer (fewer utxo.cache flushes; pair with dbcache / auto RAM budget), softens peer stall churn during deep body IBD, and defers analytics indexing until bodies catch the tip.
ibdOptimize.hint: Prioritizes headers/bodies, assumevalid, RAM-heavy UTXO connect, and pauses analytics until the tip is caught up (Bitcoin Core-style IBD focus).

blockWorkers.label: Block sync workers
blockWorkers.help: Extra peers that download block bodies in parallel during initial sync. 0 = automatic (usually 2-6).

rawBackfill.label: Tip raw-block backfill
rawBackfill.help: How many blocks at the header tip to fetch right after sync. -1 = genesis only; empty = automatic default.

reindexClear.label: Clear index first
reindexClear.help: When rebuilding the tx index, wipe indexes/tx before scanning rawblocks/. Use if the index is corrupt.

webui.label: Web dashboard listen
webui.help: Where this UI is served. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you know how to secure remote access.

rpc.label: JSON-RPC listen (optional)
rpc.help: Lets other apps call dogego RPC. Empty = disabled. Use 127.0.0.1 only on trusted machines.

uacomment.label: User-agent comment
uacomment.help: Optional string appended to the P2P version message so peers can identify your node.
uacomment.placeholder: Shown to peers in P2P handshake

pinSection.help: Optional 6-digit PIN protects wallet view and Send. Leave off to start with no PIN prompt. When enabled, both fields must be exactly 6 numbers. Hashed on disk; 3 wrong tries lock for 1 hour. Change later in Settings → Interface.

pinNow.label: Set a 6-digit PIN now (optional)
pinNow.help: Protects Send and wallet balance in this dashboard. Leave unchecked to start without a PIN prompt.

pinNew.label: 6-digit PIN
pinNew.help: Exactly six digits. Stored hashed on disk - not the same as wallet encryptwallet passphrase.

pinConfirm.label: Confirm PIN
pinConfirm.help: Must match the PIN above before the node starts.

webauthn.label: Allow device biometrics (WebAuthn) with PIN
webauthn.help: After PIN unlock, optionally use fingerprint/face on this device. Requires HTTPS or localhost.

nowebui.label: Disable web UI after start
nowebui.help: Stops serving this dashboard after the node starts (nowebui). RPC and P2P still run.

nobrowser.label: Do not open browser automatically
nobrowser.help: When off, DogeGo opens the dashboard in your default browser after start.

nowallet.label: Disable built-in wallet
nowallet.help: Runs a relay-only or watch-only node without Send/Receive in this UI.

mine.label: Solo mining on reboot testnet (mine)
mine.help: Low-difficulty testnet blocks when mine=true. Not for mainnet production mining.

showAdvanced.help: Shows peer, RPC, mempool relay, and other operator fields on later wizard steps.

profile.help: Each profile sets network, node mode, wallet, and P2P defaults. You can change everything on later steps.

dgrEnabled.label: Enable QUIC relay (DGR)
dgrEnabled.help: Master switch for the integrated QUIC CGNAT relay (P2P service bit NODE_DOGEGO_RELAY_CGNAT). Required for client or operator role.

dgrInbound.label: Inbound relay (operator)
dgrInbound.help: Listen on UDP (default 24433) for CGNAT clients. Only for nodes with a public IP and router/firewall UDP forward.

dgrOutbound.label: Outbound relay (client)
dgrOutbound.help: Dial public relays when your node cannot accept inbound P2P (Starlink, carrier NAT). Add relay host:port seeds below.

dgrListen.label: QUIC listen (UDP)
dgrListen.help: UDP bind for the operator relay, usually :24433 on all interfaces. Must match your router UDP forward.

dgrPort.label: Relay port (P2P discovery)
dgrPort.help: QUIC port other nodes use when they learn your relay from P2P (default 24433). Same port on client and operator.

dgrSeeds.label: Public relay addresses (host:port, one per line)
dgrSeeds.help: Required for client mode unless DNS TXT or a P2P peer advertises NODE_DOGEGO_RELAY_CGNAT. Example: 203.0.113.10:24433. Press Enter for each extra relay.

dgrDns.label: Relay DNS names (optional, one hostname per line)
dgrDns.help: Each hostname is looked up for DNS TXT records; each TXT line should be a relay host:port (not a Dogecoin dnsseed). Press Enter for multiple hostnames.

dgrMaxClients.label: Max inbound clients
dgrMaxClients.help: Maximum CGNAT clients registered on this inbound relay.

dgrMaxConns.label: Max outbound relay sessions
dgrMaxConns.help: Parallel QUIC tunnels to public relays from this CGNAT node.

dgrToken.label: Auth token (optional shared secret)
dgrToken.help: Shared secret between relay operator and clients. Leave empty for open relays.

dgrTlsPins.label: Relay TLS cert pins (SHA-256 hex, one per line)
dgrTlsPins.help: Optional trust pins for outbound relay dials. Copy server_cert_sha256 from your operator relay GET /api/dgr. Leave empty to accept any self-signed cert.

dgrMaxFrames.label: Max frames per session / sec
dgrMaxFrames.help: Inbound operator rate limit for DGR frames per registered client (default 60).

dgrMaxP2PProxy.label: Max P2P proxy / sec
dgrMaxP2PProxy.help: Inbound operator rate limit for P2P_FRAME proxy requests per client (default 20).

dgrMaxRegister.label: Max REGISTER / min per IP
dgrMaxRegister.help: Inbound operator cap on REGISTER attempts per client IP per minute (default 10).

dgrSection.help: DGR (DogeGo relay) uses QUIC UDP port 24433 by default, not the same as Dogecoin P2P TCP 22556. Clients dial out to operators; operators forward UDP 24433 from the internet.

simpleMode.help: Simple mode hides Explorer, Console, Docs, and other operator tabs. You can re-enable any tab below.

helpAlways.help: On mobile and narrow windows, help opens in a click popover. When pinned, it stays until you dismiss it.

pinSecurity.help: Protects wallet balance, history, and Send in this dashboard. PIN is hashed on disk (bcrypt). Three wrong attempts lock unlock for 1 hour. Optional device biometrics require PIN entry - nothing is stored in the browser.

pinCurrent.label: Current PIN (if changing)
pinCurrent.help: Required when changing or removing an existing dashboard PIN.

pinDisable.label: Disable PIN (enter current)
pinDisable.help: Enter your current PIN and click Remove PIN protection to open wallet view without unlock.

secBiometric.label: Use device biometrics after PIN (WebAuthn)
secBiometric.help: Optional faster unlock on this device after the first PIN entry in a session.

miningAddr.label: Mining address (optional)
miningAddr.help: P2PKH address for generatetoaddress / testnet solo mine payouts.

mineConfig.label: mine in config (testnet solo)
mineConfig.help: When true on reboot testnet, mines low-difficulty blocks to this node's wallet or mining address.

walletEnable.label: Enable built-in wallet
walletEnable.help: When off, sets nowallet in dogecoinconf.json. Save config and restart the node.

pqCommitments.label: Quantum-ready sends (pq_commitments)
pqCommitments.help: Adds optional quantum-ready commitment fields on sends when supported.

pqCarrier.label: PQ carrier sends (pq_carrier)
pqCarrier.help: Enables TX_C/TX_R P2SH carrier sends via dogego_sendpqcarrier and Send → Advanced carrier mode.

avoidReuse.label: Avoid address reuse (avoid_reuse)
avoidReuse.help: Prefers fresh receive addresses when building transactions.

showSummary.label: Show debug JSON on Overview → Sync
showSummary.help: Displays raw sync summary JSON for operators debugging IBD.

persistMempool.label: Persist mempool on disk (persistmempool)
persistMempool.help: Saves unconfirmed txs across restarts. Uses extra disk under the chain folder.

maxMempool.label: Max mempool (MB)
maxMempool.help: Maximum RAM for the in-memory transaction pool (-maxmempool). When full, lower-feerate txs are evicted first. Default 300 MB if left empty.

dbcache.label: DB cache / UTXO (MB)
dbcache.help: Core-style -dbcache: UTXO working-set budget before flushing utxo.cache. 0 = auto (~80% of free RAM after a 2 GB OS reserve, capped at 16 GB). Larger values speed IBD connect and reduce disk flushes. Requires restart.

mempoolExpiry.label: Mempool expiry (hours)
mempoolExpiry.help: How long an unconfirmed tx may stay in the pool before it expires (-mempoolexpiry). Default 24 hours if left empty.

maxOrphanTx.label: Max orphan txs
maxOrphanTx.help: Maximum orphan transactions held while waiting for parents (-maxorphantx).

blockMaxWeight.label: Block max weight
blockMaxWeight.help: Maximum block weight this node will accept and relay (-blockmaxweight).

minRelay.label: Min relay fee (koinu/kB)
minRelay.help: Configured minimum feerate to accept and relay txs (-minrelaytxfee). 100000 koinu/kB ≈ 0.001 DOGE/kB.

incrementalRelay.label: Incremental relay (koinu/kB)
incrementalRelay.help: Added to the rolling minimum feerate after mempool eviction (-incrementalrelayfee).

hardDust.label: Hard dust limit (koinu)
hardDust.help: Outputs below this value are treated as dust for relay (-harddustlimit).

limitAnc.label: Ancestor count
limitAnc.help: Max number of unconfirmed ancestor txs in a package (-limitancestorcount). Default 25 if empty.

limitDesc.label: Descendant count
limitDesc.help: Max descendant txs chained from one in-mempool parent (-limitdescendantcount). Default 25 if empty.

limitAncKb.label: Ancestor size (kB)
limitAncKb.help: Max combined virtual size of a tx plus all its unconfirmed ancestors (-limitancestorsize).

limitDescKb.label: Descendant size (kB)
limitDescKb.help: Max combined virtual size of a tx plus all unconfirmed descendants (-limitdescendantsize).

acceptDatacarrier.label: OP_RETURN data carrier (acceptdatacarrier)
acceptDatacarrier.help: When on, relay standard OP_RETURN data outputs. Turn off to reject OP_RETURN txs.

permitBareMs.label: Bare multisig (permitbaremultisig)
permitBareMs.help: When on, relay bare multisig outputs (older style). Turn off for stricter standardness.

datacarrierSize.label: Max OP_RETURN size (bytes)
datacarrierSize.help: Maximum OP_RETURN payload size to relay (-datacarriersize).

unverifiedMempool.label: Allow unverified mempool (testing only)
unverifiedMempool.help: Accepts txs without full validation - dangerous; for development only.

fullRbf.label: Full RBF (mempoolfullrbf)
fullRbf.help: When on, any mempool tx may be replaced by a higher-fee version, not only BIP125 opt-in RBF txs.

maxTxFee.label: Max tx fee (koinu)
maxTxFee.help: Reject txs whose fee exceeds this value (-maxtxfee).

rpcCookie.label: RPC cookie file (rpc_cookie)
rpcCookie.help: Use a cookie file for RPC auth instead of user/password.

webuiTlsLocal.label: HTTPS dashboard (webui_tls_local)
webuiTlsLocal.help: Auto-generate HTTPS for the web UI under datadir/tls/. Use https:// in the browser after restart. Combine with Trust local CA to avoid browser warnings. For DogeBox / no-TLS hosts use dogego node -notls or DOGEGO_NO_TLS=1 instead.

rpcTlsLocal.label: HTTPS JSON-RPC (rpc_tls_local)
rpcTlsLocal.help: Auto-generate HTTPS for JSON-RPC under datadir/tls/. Clients must use https:// and trust the local CA.

localTlsTrustCa.label: Trust local CA on startup (local_tls_trust_ca)
localTlsTrustCa.help: On node start, install the generated DogeGo local CA into the OS user trust store (Windows certutil, macOS security, Linux NSS). Best-effort; may need dogego tls trust-ca manually. Skipped when -notls / DOGEGO_NO_TLS is set.

rpcUser.label: RPC user
rpcUser.help: HTTP RPC username when cookie auth is disabled.

rpcPass.label: RPC password
rpcPass.help: HTTP RPC password - keep on loopback only.

coreRpcAddr.label: Core JSON-RPC address (optional)
coreRpcAddr.help: Optional host:port for Dogecoin Core on loopback (e.g. 127.0.0.1:22555 mainnet). Used only for optional side-by-side protocol parity checks in Features -  not required for sync, wallet, or P2P.

coreRpcUser.label: Core RPC user
coreRpcUser.help: Core JSON-RPC username. Empty uses DogeGo rpc_user or env DOGEGO_CORE_RPC_USER.

coreRpcPass.label: Core RPC password
coreRpcPass.help: Core JSON-RPC password paired with Core RPC user.

signerCmd.label: External signer command
signerCmd.help: HWI-compatible process (stdin/stdout JSON), e.g. python hwi.py --chain dogecoin --stdin. Enables enumeratesigners and walletprocesspsbt external signing (120s timeout; errors returned to RPC).

zmqHashblock.label: zmqpubhashblock
zmqHashblock.help: ZMQ PUB endpoint for new block hashes. Empty = disabled.

zmqHashtx.label: zmqpubhashtx
zmqHashtx.help: ZMQ PUB endpoint for new tx hashes. Empty = disabled.

zmqRawblock.label: zmqpubrawblock
zmqRawblock.help: ZMQ PUB endpoint for raw block data. Empty = disabled.

zmqRawtx.label: zmqpubrawtx
zmqRawtx.help: ZMQ PUB endpoint for raw tx data. Empty = disabled.

relayPolicy.help: Optional Core-style relay policy saved to dogecoinconf.json. Leave numbers empty to use Dogecoin defaults. Click ? on each field below for details.

settingsIntro.help: Services can be toggled live; path, network, and P2P caps need a restart.

interfaceDisplay.help: Simple mode hides Explorer, Console, Docs, and other operator tabs. You can re-enable any tab below.

overview.title: Dashboard
overview.subtitle: Live node metrics from this machine.
overview.walletLockedText: Wallet file is encrypted. Unlock spend keys to send or use extensions that need wallet_rpc.
overview.firewallCopy: Copy into an elevated Command Prompt or PowerShell (Administrator):
overview.p2pHint: How this node talks to the Dogecoin network. Change mode and limits in Settings → P2P (restart required).
overview.ibdPhaseConnect: Phase 2 of 2: validating stored blocks into chainActive (UTXO). Download continues in parallel.
overview.ibdPhaseDownload: Phase 1 of 2: downloading block bodies from peers. Headers are already at {tip}.
overview.ibdPhaseDefault: Initial block download - leave this window open; progress is saved under your data folder.
overview.ibdPhaseUtxoReplay: Replaying stored bodies to align UTXO with contiguous raw blocks - checkpointed progress survives restart.
overview.coreComparePending: Live probe pending - refreshes during IBD or open Features → Run all probes
overview.jsonRpcHint: For scripts and wallets - enable listen address in Settings.
overview.dataDirHint: Chain data for the active network lives under this folder.
overview.hashrateHint: Derived from tip difficulty - not live pool data.

send.title: Send DOGE
send.subtitle: Pay from the built-in wallet when your full node and UTXO cache are ready.
send.spvHint: SPV mode - broadcasting is not available on this run.
send.pqBannerDetail: Post-quantum OP_RETURN commitments are attached automatically on every send (FLC1 carrier).
send.advancedPqHint: Optional manual commitment override. By default DogeGo generates quantum-ready OP_RETURN proofs on each send.
send.pqDisabledHint: Post-quantum commitments are off. Enable them under Settings → Wallet to attach FLC1 proofs on each send.
send.pqCarrierHint: Carrier mode needs pq_carrier enabled under Settings → Wallet.
send.feeHint: Uses your wallet fee rate. Customize under Advanced → Fee.
send.feeRateHint: Default from wallet (settxfee). Applied to this send only.
send.subtractFee: Subtract fee from amount (recipient receives less)
send.coinControlHint: Leave empty to auto-select UTXOs. Pick specific coins when you want explicit control.
send.mainnetEncryptBody: Spending and exports are blocked on mainnet until wallet.json is encrypted. Settings → Wallet → Encrypt wallet file, or Console → encryptwallet.

receive.title: Receive DOGE
receive.subtitle: Share your address to accept payments on this network.
receive.mainnetEncryptBody: Your wallet file is still plaintext. Encrypt it under Settings → Wallet before receiving mainnet funds. PQ carrier keys stay DogeGo-specific either way.
receive.backupBody: Download a copy of wallet.json and store it offline in a safe place. Without a backup you cannot recover funds if this device fails.
receive.backupEncryptWarning: Plaintext wallet.json contains your HD seed and private keys. Dashboard PIN locks the web UI only. Run Console → encryptwallet to encrypt the wallet file on disk.
receive.backupPortableHint: Two backup paths: Download backup (wallet.json) restores this DogeGo wallet including PQ settings. For Dogecoin Core or other wallets, use Console → dumpwallet (standard DOGE keys only; PQ carrier keys are not portable).
receive.backupRotateHint: If you have not rotated keys in a while, consider moving funds to a fresh HD wallet.
receive.importWifHint: Import a mainnet or testnet private key (WIF) into this wallet.
receive.mnemonicHint: Restore an HD wallet from a BIP39 seed phrase, or sweep a BIP38 encrypted paper wallet.
receive.walletDatHint: Migrate keys from Dogecoin Core wallet.dat on this machine. Unencrypted files import natively; encrypted files decrypt natively with the wallet passphrase, or use Core RPC fallback (Settings → Advanced).
receive.walletDatDatadirHint: For security, DogeGo only reads wallet.dat inside your node datadir. Copy the file there first, then enter the path under that folder (shown in Settings → General).
receive.walletDatKeypoolHint: When probe shows pool-only rows (pool_keys_unmatched), import still succeeds - DogeGo tops up fresh HD receive keys. Matched receive pubkeys replay into wallet.json with Core pool index tags.
receive.walletDatProbeNeedsPassphrase: Encrypted wallet - enter the wallet passphrase below, then Import (native CCrypter decryption).
receive.addressBookHint: All HD, imported, watch-only, and cosigner addresses tracked in wallet.json on this node.
receive.abNewHint: Copy this address to share it. Add an optional label to find it later in your address book.
receive.signHint: Core-compatible compact signature for your wallet address.
receive.rotateHint: Auto key rotation generates a new HD wallet, sweeps your full balance to it, verifies the old wallet is empty, then switches DogeGo to the new keys. Download a backup first.
receive.rotateStep2: Prepare → sweep all coins → wait for confirmation
receive.rotateStep3: Verify empty balance → finalize → optionally delete old archive
receive.importWifOk: Imported. Rescan may take a moment.
receive.importAddrOk: Imported. Address: {address} - rescan may take a moment.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Wallet transactions on this node - search and review sends and receives.
history.pausedIbd: Wallet history paused during initial block download.
history.pausedConnectLag: Wallet history paused while the node connects blocks ({lag} behind).
history.pausedScanBuilding: Wallet rescan is building the history index - open History again after scan progress, or check Settings → Wallet.

mempool.title: Mempool
mempool.subtitle: Unconfirmed transactions held on this node only, not the whole network.
mempool.parityHint: Milestone D: stateless testmempoolaccept rows (consensus-shape and standardness rejects). Full 58-vector gate: go test ./consensus -run TestCoreMempool.
mempool.statefulHint: Offline stateful corpus runs in-process; live wallet-anchored 24/24 scenarios run on reboot testnet via scripts.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: How DogeGo works: pick a guide for your role, open files in the viewer, follow links inside each doc.

features.title: Features & protocol parity
features.subtitle: What this DogeGo build can do today vs Dogecoin Core - live flags, roadmap, and RPC catalog.
features.guidanceDogeGo: Try DogeGo when you want to
features.legendLive: Ships in this build for typical operator workflows.
features.legendPartial: Works; more soak testing or polish welcome.
features.legendDeclined: Out of scope by design (see intentional differences).
features.gapsHint: Core-compatible consensus, RPC, wallet migration, and mining ship in this build. DogeGo uses its own Go storage layout (headers/, rawblocks/, utxo.cache, Pebble wallet.db) instead of Core LevelDB. Optional long-haul soak (dogego cert live-soak, weekly-live, workflow 10) is self-certification of that layout’s resilience, not a missing Core feature. Probes above remain available when you want to run them.
features.rpcHint: Registered in this build - class from help text (live / partial / stub).
features.certHarnessHint: Offline harness: run go test ./consensus/... -run TestCore and PowerShell scripts under scripts/.
features.certLiveHint: Seventeen loopback checks on this DogeGo node. Comparing to Dogecoin Core is optional (Settings → Advanced → core_rpc_addr). Solo N/17 counts optional Core gates as pass when Core is not configured.
features.certScriptHint: Run from repo root with DOGEGO_* env flags. Disruptive gates are testnet/dev only.
features.coreCompareHint: Optional reference check against Dogecoin Core's original protocol (getblockchaininfo, verifychain). DogeGo is fully autonomous without Core. Set core_rpc_addr in Settings → Advanced only if you want side-by-side parity.
features.coreMaintHint: Milestone E: verifychain, getindexinfo, getchaintxstats, getblockfilter - mirrors scripts/core_maintenance_workflow.ps1.
features.coreResumeHint: Milestone E: rawblocks_sync checkpoint vs contiguous bodies and IBD assist pool - mirrors scripts/core_restart_resume_check.ps1.
features.coreIbdConvergeHint: Milestone E: headers, contiguous bodies, connect boost, body coverage. Timed window: dogego cert ibd-convergence or scripts/ibd_convergence_check.ps1.
features.coreAddrmanHint: Partial Core addrman: getaddrmaninfo bucket stats cross-checked against getblockchaininfo dogego_addrbook_* fields.
features.coreAutostartHint: Verify OS sign-in startup matches autostart=login in dogecoinconf.json - mirrors dogego cert autostart.
features.coreAutostartOffHint: autostart=disable - enable login autostart in Settings → Interface or the setup wizard.
features.coreRunnerHint: Provision checklist + reboottestnet RPC preflight for dogego-live runners - mirrors dogego cert weekly; full bundle: dogego cert weekly-live; Milestone B soak: dogego cert live-soak.
features.coreProbesHint: One-click loopback checks on this DogeGo node (maintenance, restart-resume, wallet, BIP152, reindex, end-to-end, …). Side-by-side compare with Dogecoin Core is optional -  leave core_rpc_addr empty for a fully autonomous node.
features.coreWalletHint: Milestone E: getwalletinfo, getbalance, getnewaddress, validateaddress - mirrors scripts/core_wallet_workflow.ps1 when wallet is enabled.
features.coreProbeApisHint: Loopback JSON endpoints for operator scripts and the Features tab bundle.
features.coreE2eHint: Milestone E: node health, restart-resume, maintenance, reindex, BIP152 HB, wallet - checked live inside the node (no PowerShell required).
features.coreFieldEvidenceHint: Offline committed mainnet block/header corpus plus live dogedata/mainnet readiness for TestCoreMainnetFieldHeaderPoW and field_disk_connect_cert.ps1.
features.coreReindexHint: Milestone E: getrpcinfo method presence + getindexinfo sync state - mirrors scripts/core_reindex_prune_workflow.ps1 (check-only).
features.coreBip152Hint: Milestone E: getpeerinfo bip152_hb_to/from and HB negotiate when caught up - mirrors scripts/core_bip152_probe.ps1.
features.coreMiningHint: Core-shaped mining RPCs: getmininginfo + getblocktemplate (Digishield bits, BIP22 longpoll) + createauxblock in aux era. Run probe to verify; optional Core GBT compare when tips align.
features.corePqHint: Offline OP_RETURN + TX_C/TX_R. Falcon/Dilithium are pure-Go; Raccoon-G is the vendored Foundation in-tree port by Ed Tubbs (CGO -tags raccoon_g; no placeholder). Verifier-side only; not production PQ safety.

blockstep.title: BlockStep
blockstep.subtitle: Step through blocks one at a time.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.subtitle: Search blocks, transactions, and addresses on this node.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Local chain analytics from the embedded sidecar.
analytics.ibdFocusBody: Heavy analytics indexing is paused so the node can reach the tip faster. Charts and catalog metrics unlock after IBD completes.
analytics.peersHint: Live P2P sessions (getpeerinfo). Manage manual peers below; add/remove applies without restart.
analytics.peersEmpty: No peers connected yet. Check Settings → P2P mode and firewall rules.
analytics.peersDgrUsing: This node is tunneling P2P via DGR relay
analytics.addedHint: Persistent peers saved to config. Remove disconnects matching sessions when possible (primary sync peer stays up).
analytics.reorgHint: Recorded when this node elects a heavier fork and truncates the header tip. Includes displaced miners, AuxPoW, and UTC hour for correlation. Persists in dogego_analytics.db (mainnet and testnet each have their own chain folder).

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.subtitle: Install optional packages, enable or disable. Open an enabled extension for its workspace menu. Wallet use is allowlisted RPC only (no key export).
extensions.devManualHint: How to build and package extensions for DogeGo.

console.title: Console
console.subtitle: JSON-RPC against this node (loopback only) and the in-memory activity log.
console.coreProbesHint: Loopback GET probes on this DogeGo node. Optional Dogecoin Core reference compare only when core_rpc_addr is set in Settings → Advanced.
console.tutorialHint: Use the RPC form for in-process calls (no HTTP auth). The cookbook lists every method with curl and CLI examples.
console.cookbookHint: All supported JSON-RPC methods from this build. Click Use in Console to fill the form; copy curl or CLI for scripts.

modals.unlockLead: Your wallet file is encrypted. Enter the passphrase to load spend keys (Core walletpassphrase).
modals.unlockHint: Separate from the dashboard PIN. CLI: dogego-cli walletpassphrase "…" 600

blockTip.label: Block tip
blockTip.help: Best connected block height on a full node. In SPV mode this shows the header tip instead.

headerTip.label: Header tip
headerTip.help: Best block height on the header chain your node has validated. May run ahead of downloaded blocks during sync.

sync.label: Sync
sync.help: Sync progress during IBD. Connected height is chainActive; stored bodies may run ahead while blocks validate.

mempool.label: Mempool
mempool.help: Transactions waiting in your node's memory pool before inclusion in a block.

txProcessed.label: Tx processed
txProcessed.help: Cumulative transactions indexed on the connected chain (from tx index when enabled).

peers.label: Peers
peers.help: Outbound connections your node opened, and inbound connections from other nodes (when listening).

network.label: Network
network.help: mainnet is production Dogecoin. testnet is the reboot test chain in this repository.

chainDisk.label: Chain disk
chainDisk.help: Total size under your network datadir (headers, rawblocks, indexes).
